calls.head: San Jose gives up shots, and Los Angeles takes them
calls.body: Los Angeles ranks 8th of 32 for shot volume (59.9 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); San Jose ranks 23rd for shot suppression.
calls.call: Los Angeles takes at least its usual 59.9 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 1 games this season
calls.happened: Los Angeles took 61.6 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5 (adjusted for score and venue), against its usual 59.9.

calls.head: San Jose hunts better looks than Los Angeles
calls.body: San Jose ranks 14th of 32 for shot quality, toward the point-blank end; Los Angeles ranks 32nd, toward the perimeter end.
calls.call: San Jose’s shots are more dangerous on average than Los Angeles’s.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 1 games this season
calls.happened: On how dangerous the average unblocked shot was, San Jose had 1 goal per 25.1 shots and Los Angeles 1 goal per 15.0 shots. Coming in, San Jose was at 1 goal per 15.7 shots and Los Angeles at 1 goal per 17.4 shots.
calls.usual: SJS 1 goal per 15.7 shots · LAK 1 goal per 17.4 shots
calls.tonight: SJS 1 goal per 25.1 shots · LAK 1 goal per 15.0 shots

SJS.head: We had this close to even (48% for San Jose), and San Jose came through.

LAK.head: We had this close to even (52% for Los Angeles), and it went San Jose’s way.

surprises.head: San Jose won against the run of play
surprises.body: Replaying this game’s chances, Los Angeles comes out ahead 83 times in 100. San Jose won anyway.

surprises.head: San Jose was kept to the outside
surprises.body: San Jose needed 25.1 unblocked shots per expected goal at 5-on-5, against its usual 15.7 and a league average of 15.9. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 50 games.

surprises.head: A rough night for A. Forsberg
surprises.body: A. Forsberg allowed 5 goals on shots worth 1.7 expected goals, 3.3 more than expected. Starting goalies had a night this rough about once every 45 starts over the last three seasons.
